sources.observation: Browser-rendered official guide: KVS supported; KVS Vault unsupported; services belong to the same application; instances expire within 12 hours.
Browser-rendered official Notes: Commiter and up required; not intended for performance/stress testing.
Browser-rendered BC commands: add an existing service from the application; name is case-sensitive; no beta flag documented.
Browser-rendered KVS guide explicitly documents real Fury services through Sandbox.
Browser-rendered CLI reference describes real replicas with lifecycle/throughput/operation-permission limits.

beta.limit: No beta label in inspected pages and no search results do not establish GA or account-specific eligibility. KVS Release Notes page remained Loading and is not used as evidence.
beta.cli_beta_enrollment: Installed Fury CLI beta enrollment concerns CLI version requests; it does not prove Sandbox beta.

clone_403.inventory_limit: approved/database/test=true establishes visibility, not Sandbox eligibility; database alone does not exclude Vault.
clone_403.next_action: Confirm effective Commiter-or-higher role and eligibility of the own CP alias; obtain the backend reason for clone403. No account permission or service setting was changed.

independent_review.scope: Inference classification only; not independent browser reading or full E2E certification
independent_review.finding: No beta/GA or role/Vault/test causation claim is justified by current evidence.
